actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.get#History').parameters({wikiPageId: wikiPageId || null, wikiSpaceId: wikiSpaceId || null, pagePath: pagePath || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {versionList: out.versionList, historyList: out.historyList, currentVersionName: out.currentVersionName, publishedVersionName: out.publishedVersionName, storage: out.storage, canRestore: out.canRestore, canPublish: out.canPublish})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.get#VersionDiff').parameters({wikiPageId: wikiPageId || null, wikiSpaceId: wikiSpaceId || null, pagePath: pagePath || '', fromVersionName: fromVersionName || null, toVersionName: toVersionName || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {fromVersionName: out.fromVersionName, toVersionName: out.toVersionName, fromShort: out.fromShort, toShort: out.toShort, html: out.html, stats: out.stats})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.shared.ChatterServices.search#Users').parameters({term: term || '', limit: 12}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? [] : Array.from(out.userList || []).map((user) => ({value: user.value, label: user.label})))

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.search#LinkRecords').parameter('term', term || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? [] : (out.optionList || []))

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.save#Page').parameters({wikiPageId: wikiPageId || null, wikiSpaceId: wikiSpaceId || null, pagePath: pagePath || '', pageText: pageText ?? '', versionNote: versionNote || null, baseVersionName: baseVersionName || null, force: String(force) === 'true', collab: String(collab) === 'true'}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) { ec.web.sendJsonResponse({}); return } const message = out.conflict ? null : out.versionName ? ec.resource.expand('Saved as version ${name}', '', {name: String(out.versionName).length > 12 ? String(out.versionName).substring(0, 10) : out.versionName}) : ec.l10n.localize('No changes to save') ec.web.sendJsonResponse({wikiPageId: out.wikiPageId, wikiSpaceId: out.wikiSpaceId, pagePath: out.pagePath, versionName: out.versionName, currentVersionName: out.currentVersionName, conflict: out.conflict, conflictText: out.conflictText, savedText: out.savedText, messageInfos: message ? [{type: 'success', message: message}] : []})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.create#Page').parameters({wikiSpaceId: wikiSpaceId || '', parentPath: parentPath || '', pageName: pageName || '', pageText: pageText || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {wikiPageId: out.wikiPageId, pagePath: out.pagePath, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.resource.expand('Page ${name} created', '', {name: pageName})}]})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.move#Page').parameters({wikiPageId: wikiPageId || '', toWikiSpaceId: toWikiSpaceId || null, toParentPath: toParentPath || '', toPageName: toPageName || null, versionNote: versionNote || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {wikiSpaceId: out.wikiSpaceId, pagePath: out.pagePath, replayed: out.replayed, versionCount: out.versionCount, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: out.replayed ? ec.resource.expand('Moved, with its ${count} versions', '', {count: out.versionCount}) : ec.l10n.localize('Moved')}]})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.publish#Version').parameters({wikiPageId: wikiPageId || '', versionName: versionName || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {publishedVersionName: out.publishedVersionName, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Published')}]})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.restore#Version').parameters({wikiPageId: wikiPageId || '', versionName: versionName || '', versionNote: versionNote || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {newVersionName: out.newVersionName, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Restored as the newest version')}]})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.request#Review').parameters({wikiPageId: wikiPageId || '', versionName: versionName || null, reviewerUserIds: reviewerUserIds || null, dueDate: dueDate || null, note: note || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {wikiPageReviewId: out.wikiPageReviewId, wikiPageReviewIdList: out.wikiPageReviewIdList, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Review requested')}]})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.decide#Review').parameters({wikiPageReviewId: wikiPageReviewId || '', decision: decision || '', decisionNote: decisionNote || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {statusId: out.statusId, publishedVersionName: out.publishedVersionName, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize(out.statusId === 'WprApproved' ? 'Approved and published' : 'Changes requested')}]})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.set#PageTags').parameters({wikiPageId: wikiPageId || '', tags: tags || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {tagList: out.tagList})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.upload#Attachment').parameters({wikiPageId: wikiPageId || '', attachmentFile: attachmentFile || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {filenameList: out.filenameList, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.resource.expand('${count} added', '', {count: (out.filenameList || []).length})}]})

ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.delete#Attachment').parameters({wikiPageId: wikiPageId || '', filename: filename || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Removed')}]})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.follow#Page').parameters({wikiPageId: wikiPageId || '', follow: String(follow) !== 'false'}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {following: out.following, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize(out.following ? 'Watching this page' : 'Stopped watching this page')}]})

ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.unlink#PageRecord').parameters({wikiPageId: wikiPageId || '', recordEntityName: recordEntityName || '', recordId: recordId || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {})
